name: @artifactbin/contracts
description: The types every artifactbin service speaks: parts, the upstream seam, actors, identity, sharing, relations, agents, account resources, the sql, browser and events services, a queryable database. Types, constants and the small pure helpers that derive from them (denyResponse, declaredAgentSlug, eventName, isQueryFailure) — no runtime dependencies (hono is a type-only peer).
